verdict.rationale: The aihero.dev/skills page is a browsable catalog: it lists each skill with a one-line description and tells you to 'pick the skills… install the ones you want' before installing. The bundle is also listed in Claude Code's official plugin marketplace and installable via Codex and Copilot marketplace commands. Missing for 10: any evidence of search or filtering within the catalog, a cross-author registry or leaderboard view (the listing covers only this one author's set), and independent hands-on corroboration of the browsing experience.
